name: Liquid Glass
oneLiner: Translucent, layered surfaces with specular edges, saturated backdrops, and spring-weighted motion — depth you can almost touch.

motion.reducedMotion: keep opacity and color transitions, drop transforms and springs, cap every duration at 60ms

primary.base: height: 48px; padding: 0 24px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--uiux-color-accent); color: var(--uiux-color-accent-text); font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 #FFFFFF59, 0 8px 24px #1856FF38; transition: transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.22,0.61,0.36,1)

glass.base: height: 48px; padding: 0 24px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--uiux-color-surface); backdrop-filter: saturate(160%) blur(18px); border: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-border); color: var(--uiux-color-text); font-weight: 500

padding: 24px; border-radius: 24px; background: var(--uiux-color-surface); backdrop-filter: saturate(160%) blur(18px); border: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-border); box-shadow: 0 12px 32px #090C141A, inset 0 1px 0 #FFFFFF80

default.base: height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 16px; background: var(--uiux-color-surface); border: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-border); color: var(--uiux-color-text); backdrop-filter: blur(12px)

bar.base: position: sticky; top: 0; height: 64px; padding: 0 24px; border-radius: 0 0 20px 20px; background: var(--uiux-color-surface); backdrop-filter: saturate(180%) blur(20px); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-border)

default.header: text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; font-size: 0.6875rem; color: var(--uiux-color-text-muted)

default.base: height: 24px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--uiux-color-surface-alt); border: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-border); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500

do: Layer at most three translucent planes; each extra plane halves legibility.
Give every glass surface a specular top edge with an inset highlight, never a flat drop shadow alone.
Put the color story in a blurred background (gradient, photo, or artwork) and keep the foreground chrome neutral.
Animate transforms and opacity; reserve spring easing for entrances and dismissals.
dont: Do not place glass surfaces on a flat white background — the effect reads as a plain card.
Do not use more than 20px of blur on text-bearing surfaces.
Do not mix glass with hard 2px borders or square corners.
Do not stack backdrop-filter on scrolling lists; it compounds cost per row.
antiPatterns: Frosted card on pure white with no backdrop color: the style collapses into generic card UI.
Every surface translucent, including body text containers, producing a hazy unreadable page.
Blur applied per list item instead of one shared surface behind the list.

notes: Composite translucent surfaces over the actual backdrop before checking contrast; a 66% white layer over a pastel gradient is not white.
Keep body text on the opaque end of the surface scale; reserve the most translucent layer for decorative chrome.
Provide the reduced-motion variant: opacity-only transitions, no scale or spring, and no parallax.
